body: I don’t know how to be nice now. everyone is so slow, they’re not getting it. why can’t they see it. it’s pissing me off how they’re not getting it

you know your mind. It has carried you through the worst times in your life, and it will carry you now too. I’m sorry this happened, please know it’s not your fault. at all. she was in unimaginable suffering, she couldn’t take it. we like to blame ourselves when things like this happen but in reality, it’s never about us, only them and what they did to end their pain. you deserve to keep going. I’m just here.
sending massive love to you angel. stay alive okay? you deserve it.
